content.value_statement: Nuxt projects require current patterns for routing, server APIs, middleware, and runtime configuration. This skill gives focused Nuxt 4 guidance with links to relevant reference files.
actual_capabilities: Guides Nuxt server route, middleware, WebSocket, SSE, and cached function patterns.
Explains file-based routing, route groups, layouts, typed navigation, and dynamic route naming.
Shows Nuxt composables for URL handling, navigation, data fetching, state, head, and SEO metadata.
Covers runtimeConfig, modules, auto-imports, layers, route rules, and environment variable conventions.
Highlights Nuxt 4 changes from older Nuxt patterns and when to consult official docs.
limitations: It is reference guidance, not an automated project generator.
It does not replace official documentation for new or module-specific changes.
It does not execute Nuxt commands, install packages, or inspect a project by itself.
Examples use placeholder endpoints and must be adapted before production.

use_cases.title: Create Server APIs
use_cases.description: Design API routes, middleware, validation, cached functions, SSE, and WebSocket handlers.

use_cases.title: Modernize Routing
use_cases.description: Update pages, layouts, route groups, typed navigation, and migration patterns for Nuxt 4.

use_cases.title: Configure Runtime Settings
use_cases.description: Plan runtimeConfig, modules, environment variables, route rules, and monorepo setup conventions.

prompt_templates.title: Find the Right Nuxt Reference
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Nuxt 4 goal and point me to the relevant skill references. Focus on routing, server, composables, or configuration.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Server Route
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a Nuxt 4 server route for [feature]. Include validation, error handling, and the matching file path.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Routing Patterns
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these Nuxt pages and navigation patterns for Nuxt 4. Recommend route groups, typed navigation, and layout changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Production Configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Nuxt 4 runtime configuration plan for [app]. Cover private secrets, public config, validation, route rules, and deployment checks.

output_examples.input: I need a Nuxt API endpoint for user profiles.
output: The response identifies the recommended file path and request method.
It lists validation, error handling, and server utility concerns.
It notes caching or middleware guidance when useful.

output_examples.input: My app still uses older routing patterns.
output_examples.output: The skill identifies Nuxt 4 routing replacements, typed navigation targets, and layout changes to review.

output_examples.input: I need environment variables for production.
output_examples.output: The response separates private runtime configuration from public values and suggests schema validation.

best_practices: Load only the reference file that matches the current Nuxt task.
Prefer Nuxt 4 conventions, including typed routes and server utilities.
Verify new features against official Nuxt, h3, or Nitro documentation.
anti_patterns: Applying every reference file to small tasks.
Using older Nuxt examples without checking Nuxt 4 changes.
Putting private secrets in public runtime configuration or app config.

faq.question: Does this skill write code automatically?
faq.answer: It provides guidance and examples. The AI assistant still needs project context before editing files.

faq.question: Which Nuxt version does it target?
faq.answer: It targets Nuxt 4.3 and newer patterns, with h3 v1 and Nitro v2 references.

faq.question: Can it help with server APIs?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers API routes, server middleware, validation, cached functions, WebSocket, and SSE patterns.

faq.question: Does it include UI components?
faq.answer: It covers Nuxt built-in components. It points to related skills for broader UI libraries.

faq.question: How does it handle secrets?
faq.answer: It recommends private runtimeConfig for secrets and public runtimeConfig only for client-safe values.

faq.question: Should I fetch latest docs?
faq.answer: Fetch official docs for new features, module details, breaking changes, or advanced cases not covered here.
